title: 195. Your Family Vacation Survival Guide: Coping Skills, Boundaries, & More!
description_html: In this week's solo episode, I talk about how to handle family vacations this summer. The uncertainty and social dynamics that come with family vacations can be a stressor for many people— you're not alone! So, I share my favorite coping skills you can use to handle any challenges that come your way this summer.
talk_about: The importance of recharging your social battery for your mental health
Understanding your family's expectations for your vacation
How to prepare for extended periods of time with your family
Coping skills for if you're experiencing stress or conflict on a trip
Tips for practicing your communication skills & setting boundaries
Why family vacations can make you extra emotionally vulnerable
Practicing gratitude & how that can help your overall family dynamic
mentioned_html: + Mini: Two Quick Tricks to Prevent a Panic Attack
summary: sadie shares practical skills for handling family vacations when they feel stressful or overwhelming. she talks about knowing your social battery as an introvert or extrovert, planning coping skills ahead of time (like stop, deep breathing, grounding), and how to set boundaries with family using dear man. she also covers why trips make you more emotionally vulnerable, how to check in during and after the trip, and why reinforcing positive moments helps everyone show up better next time. listeners learn concrete ways to recharge, communicate needs, and use distraction or grounding when anxiety or conflict comes up.
quote: when you're on any kind of trip or in a new environment, you're not able to be on autopilot and use your same skills and routines, so your support system is going to look different.

paragraphs.text: Welcome to She Persisted. I'm your host, Sadie Sutton, a 19-year-old from the Bay Area studying psychology at the University of Pennsylvania. She Persisted offers you a safe space to feel validated and understood in your struggle, while encouraging you to take ownership of your journey and build your life worth living. So let's dive in.
